description: VS Code atomic save: the new contents are written to a sibling temp file (`notes.org.tmp-a1b2c3`) which is then atomically renamed onto `notes.org`. The rename surfaces as one event listing both paths `[temp, target]`; only `notes.org` is a genuine target. One logical save; `notes.org` must coalesce to exactly one FileChanged. Offsets are milliseconds from the start of the save burst. Modeled on VS Code's atomic write-then-rename save path — not a live capture.
